verdict.rationale: A compliance-deadline calendar with reminders is a fair question for a legal and agreement-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no compliance calendar of filing deadlines and no reminders before them. The only related item, an MCP connector that can 'query agreement status and key dates' (docusign-docs-47), covers agreement data access rather than a filing-deadline calendar with reminders, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one
